relationships.subject: mechanical stress
relationships.evidence_quote: Exposure to cyclic mechanical stretching induced a significant mRNA and protein expression of VEGF only in endothelial AVM cells

relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant reduction of the VEGF protein levels was only achieved by bevacizumab, but not thalidomide

relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The proliferation assay revealed a significant inhibition of endothelial AVM cell proliferation with 1000 µg/ml bevacizumab

relationships.subject: HIF-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: Hypoxia activates the hypoxia-inducible transcription factor (HIF-1α) signaling pathway and angiogenesis by regulating the expression of NOTCH1, angiopoietin2 (ANGPT2) and VEGF-A [24].

key_findings: Mechanical stress increased VEGF expression in AVM endothelial cells; bevacizumab reduced VEGF protein and circular network formation in vitro.
Bevacizumab controlled bleeding, pulsation and pain in three AVM patients over follow-up.
